_comment: Per-product affiliate link overrides: plant_id -> retailer_id -> URL.
These replace the outbound buy URL for one specific product at one
specific retailer. Nothing else in the pipeline is affected: prices,
ranking, and which retailers appear are all computed from scraped data
and never consult this file. That separation is deliberate — the moment
monetization can influence ranking, the comparison is worthless.
Note the affiliate blocks in data/retailers.json are RESEARCH NOTES about
programs that could be joined, not programs that have been joined. Their
link_template fields are all empty and build.py has never read them. This
file holds links that actually exist.
Currently: one link, created during Sovrn Commerce onboarding, which
requires a live link and a click before it will review the site.
